         MT-GUI Public Notifications You must be signed in to change notification settings Fork 0  ( 0 ) Star 0  ( 0 ) You must be signed in to star a repository About Metamorphic Testing of Multimodal LLMs as GUI Test Oracles Resources Readme License Activity Stars 0  stars Watchers 0  watching Forks 0  forks Report repository main Branches Tags Go to file Code Open more actions menu Latest commit   History 1 Commit 1 Commit Folders and files Name Name Last commit message Last commit date analysis analysis     scripts scripts     .gitignore .gitignore     LICENSE LICENSE     README.md README.md     requirements.txt requirements.txt     View all files Repository files navigation README License More  items MT-GUI: Metamorphic Testing of Multimodal LLMs as GUI Test Oracles 
 MT-GUI tests multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that act as GUI test oracles. It derives follow-up screenshots and prompts from metamorphic relations, tests every relation against the flakiness baseline of a repeated query, and gates verdicts with a consistency-weighted confidence (CWC) calibrated by conformal risk control. 
 This repository contains the experiment console, the complete raw answers of all eight models, and the analysis code that reproduces every number, table and figure of the paper. 
 Reproduction package for peer review 
 This package contains everything needed to reproduce every number, table and figure of the manuscript: the complete raw answers of all eight models and the analysis code. The experiment console that generated the queries is not part of this package and will be released with the full repository upon publication. 
 
 
 
 Path 
 Content 
 
 
 
 
 analysis/data/MTGUI_results.json.gz 
 All 53,719 raw model answers with timestamps, token counts, providers and costs 
 
 
 analysis/analysis.py 
 Main analysis: accuracy, flip rates, McNemar and Holm tests, GEE, CWC and the conformal gate 
 
 
 analysis/figs_rq.py 
 Figure panels of RQ1 to RQ4 
 
 
 analysis/extra_analyses.py ,  si_more.py ,  joint_analysis*.py 
 Supplementary analyses and tables 
 
 
 analysis/revision_analyses.py 
 Equivalence tests, per-model GEE fits, trend tests, CWC ablations, the expected-type check and the serving settings 
 
 
 analysis/dataflow.py 
 Per-model data flow 
 
 
 analysis/lib/ 
 Shared statistics helpers 
 
 
 analysis/out/ 
 Precomputed results for comparison 
 
 
 
 Reproducing the analysis 
 pip install -r requirements.txt
 cd  analysis
python analysis.py             #  about 5 minutes on the first run 
python figs_rq.py
python extra_analyses.py
python revision_analyses.py
python dataflow.py 
 The outputs match the files in  analysis/out/ .
